en: The spiritual element of religion consists in this, that man sets himself into relation with the absolute being, strives to produce his unification with it and to become conscious of this unification.
zh: 宗教中精神的东西，在于人与绝对存在者发生关系，努力产生自己同它的合一，并力求对这种合一有自觉。

en: Chasm between the finite and the infinite.
We first make this chasm.
Not one-sided, but equally a coming-toward, a condescension of God, divine grace; – (religion of fear and of love, both necessary and essential.)
zh: 有限者与无限者之间的鸿沟。
我们首先来造成这一鸿沟。
这不是单方面的，而是同样也是上帝的趋就、上帝的俯就，是神圣的恩典；——（恐惧的宗教与爱的宗教，二者都是必要的、本质的。）

en: This doing is not one-sided, and religion is not merely a subjective elevation, a veneration on the part of man, but it presupposes that God on his part draws near to man, and it is a trust in divine grace.
zh: 这一行动并不是单方面的，宗教也不只是一种主观的提升、来自人一方的崇敬，而是它以上帝在他那一方临近于人为前提，并且是对神圣恩典的信任。

en: Religion is in and for itself an absolute doing; – not an arbitrary one of men for their own good; the life of God in his congregation.
Bodily eating and drinking; – scientific, legal life – purpose: bodily existence.
Religion [is said to be] useful, even if there is no objective truth in it.
zh: 宗教自在自为地本身就是一种绝对的行动；——不是人们为了自己的好处而任意做的事；上帝在其教团中的生命。
肉身的饮食；——学术的、法权的生命——目的：肉身的存在。
宗教［人们说，是］有用的，即使其中没有客观真理。

en: This spiritual reciprocal relation and reciprocal doing constitutes the principle of living religion, and its real presentation is the cultus of the veneration of God.
zh: 这种精神的相互关系与交互行动，构成活的宗教的原则，而其现实的表现就是敬神的礼拜。

en: Moral religion too is in this way something subjective, built on morality, and the end is the morality of man.
zh: 道德宗教同样也是这样一种主观的东西，建立在道德之上，而目的是人的道德。

en: Because God is spirit, he is not to be regarded as the unmoved being, but as absolute actuality, first as the living God who presents and reveals his shape in nature.
zh: 上帝因为是精神，所以不应被看作不动的存在者，而应被看作绝对的能动性，首先作为活的上帝，他在自然中展现并启示出自己的形态。

en: To this belongs, first, to know what the essence and the doing of God is; instruction on this subject was formerly the office of wise men and the original absolute vocation of art and especially of poetry.
It is, on the one hand, an interpretation of nature and of history, on the other hand, a shaping of the thought of God and of his doing for external perception and representation.
zh: 首先属于此的是：要知道上帝的本质和行动是什么；关于这一点的教诲，曾经是智慧者的职责，是艺术尤其是诗艺原初的、绝对的使命。
它一方面是对自然与历史的阐释，另一方面是把关于上帝及其行动的思想加以形态化，以供外在的感知与表象。

en: The books of the Bible are rhythmical, poems, not prose.
Homer contains a world, a universe – out of the inner life of his nation, as if this nation itself had sung it.
Homer not an individual. – God reveals himself in nature and history – it is his doing; but the main thing [is] to recognize him in it.
zh: 《圣经》的各书是有节奏的，是诗，不是散文。
荷马包含着一个世界、一个宇宙——出自他那个民族的内在生命，仿佛是这个民族自己把它歌唱出来的。
荷马不是个体。——上帝在自然与历史中启示自己——这是他的行动；但关键在于［要］在其中认识到他。

en: Festivals, agricultural ones, for the benefit of horse-breeding.
zh: 节庆，农业性的，以有利于养马为目的。

en: With the ancients, that they celebrated a divine doing to the honour, not to a use or purpose (of war), but for its own sake [feiern].
zh: 在古代人那里，他们把一个神圣的行动［举行］起来，是为了荣耀，不是为了效用或目的（战争的目的），而是为了它本身。

en: Mythology, myths.
zh: 神话学，神话。

en: Prophets, to whom the spirit, God, Apollo has revealed it; they do not speak out of themselves; natural genius; – but divine inspiration,
zh: 先知们，是精神、上帝、阿波罗向他们作了启示，他们并不是从自身说话；自然的天才；——而是神圣的灵感，

en: Pain, sacrifice of himself; Homer, an old blind man.
zh: 痛苦，对自身的牺牲；荷马，年迈的盲人。

en: Pathos.
zh: 激情。

en: Hesiod’s Theogony.
zh: 赫西俄德的《神谱》。

en: Orpheus introduced Thracian mysteries.
zh: 俄耳甫斯引入了色雷斯的秘仪。

en: Greek priests in part, in part the kings themselves sacrificed.
zh: 希腊人一部分由祭司、一部分由国王亲自献祭。

en: Nature must be revealed by men, God reveals himself.
zh: 自然必须由人来加以启示，上帝则启示他自己。

en: Women gave themselves up in honour of Venus Astarte; this was the divine doing.
zh: 女人们为崇敬维纳斯·阿斯塔忒而把自己交了出去；这就是那神圣的行动。

en: God lives in his congregation; among the Greeks only individual appearances and actions of the same.
zh: 上帝生活在他自己的教团中；在希腊人那里只有上帝的个别显现与行动。

en: Oracles about individual events.
zh: 关于个别事件的神谕。

en: Poetry becomes symbolic – as it contains ideas.
Art and poetry are not adornments.
zh: 诗艺成为象征性的——当它包含观念的时候。
艺术与诗艺不是装饰。

en: Interpretation; theogony, mythology in general.
zh: 阐释；神谱，神话学全般。

en: Aesopic fable; – the eagle’s nest was burned down through coals which it had brought thither with meat from an altar. – The bat.
zh: 伊索式的寓言；——鹰巢毁于炭火，那炭是鹰从祭坛上同肉一起衔去的。——蝙蝠。

en: The course of the stars, a divine doing.
zh: 天体的运行，是一种神圣的行动。

en: Nestor in Homer, when the sea roared while Achilles sat alone in his pain (or at his burial in the Odyssey), explains this as the coming of his mother.
zh: 荷马笔下的涅斯托耳，当大海轰鸣、阿基琉斯正陷于痛苦中独坐之时（或在《奥德赛》里他的葬礼之际），把这解释为其母亲的来临。

en: Priests: constant interpretation; premonitions – all a meaning of a divine doing; appearances, events; –
zh: 祭司，持续不断的阐释；先兆——一切都是某个神圣行动的意义；显现、事件；——

en: Shaping; search after shape, real presence, imperfection of the thought – first stars; flowers; animals, human shape; the real man himself –
zh: 形态化；对形态的寻求，现实的临在，思想的不完善——先是星辰；花朵；动物，人的形态；现实的人自身——

en: Theogony, universal divine doing, generation of the gods; the main event, the overthrow of the Titans, old and new gods – symbolism.
zh: 神谱，普遍的神圣行动，诸神的生成；主要事件是提坦的倾覆，旧神与新神——象征体系。

en: Transformations into flowers; origin of the roses; drops of divine blood.
zh: 化为花朵；玫瑰的由来；神圣之血的滴珠。

en: Ovid’s Metamorphoses; such a cultivation of consciousness as his elaboration and formation brings into it, contrasted with the form of spirit in which the content comes to pass; truth has a quite different meaning.
zh: 奥维德的《变形记》；他的加工与塑形所注入的，是这样一种意识的教养，同内容得以发生的精神的形态形成对照；真理有着完全不同的意义。

en: Interpretation of nature, flowers, spiritualization, apprehension of their character.
zh: 对自然的阐释，花朵，精神化，把握它们的性格。

en: Interpretation of lightnings etc., with Moses the burning bush; a divine doing; beholding God in all.
zh: 对雷电等的阐释，摩西那里的燃烧的荆棘；一种神圣的行动；在万物中观看上帝。

en: Recognizing.
zh: 认识。

en: The instruction is, more precisely, first an interpretation of nature as a divine doing, in fables and myths, and in relation to human doing as a sign.
Secondly, moral instruction points out to man, in the consciousness of his reason, the divine law, which for the particulars of his acting is the universal determining principle.
The third instruction concerns the self-subsistent nature of God and of his acting.
zh: 这种教诲更切近地说，其一是对作为某种神圣行动的自然之阐释，见于寓言与神话之中，以及同作为征兆的人的行动的关系。
其二，道德的教诲在人对其理性的意识中，向人指出神圣的法则，这法则对于其行为的个别内容来说，就是起决定作用的普遍原理。
第三项教诲关乎上帝的独立本性及其行为。

en: Assurance of his inner being, what man knows, intuits, feels, resolves within himself – as an in-itself beyond his contingent consciousness as nature.
When man sees, feels, recognizes God, then he is present.
Directing attention to his inner being; – the daemon of Socrates, morality.
zh: 对其内心生活的确信，人在自身中所知道、所直观、所感觉、所决定的东西——作为在他那作为自然的偶然意识之外的一个自在者。
当人看见上帝、感觉到上帝、认识上帝时，上帝就是临在的。
使人注意其内心的东西；——苏格拉底的精灵，道德。

en: (The shaping of what is divine for intuition and representation is the work of beautiful art.
zh: （把神圣的东西形态化以供直观与表象，是美的艺术的作品。

en: In the cultus man as individual gives himself the consciousness of his real and felt unity with the divine being, in that in devotion he theoretically forgets himself in him, practically sacrifices his property, and in the enjoyment of the real presence becomes conscious of it within himself.)
zh: 在崇拜中，人作为个体给自己造成一种意识：他同神圣存在者有现实的、被感觉到的一致——他在虔诚中于上帝之内理论上忘掉了自己，实践上从自己的财产中作出牺牲，并在对现实临在的享受中于自身之内获得了自觉。）

en: The becoming and the connection of unconscious nature is recognized as a divine doing or as a divine image of the nature of spirit only in philosophy.88)
zh: 无意识的自然的生成与关联，只有在哲学中才被认识为一种神圣的行动，或者被认识为精神的本性的神圣摹本。88)

en: The unrecognized connection of self-conscious action and its outcomes is as fate or necessity.
zh: 有自我意识的行动及其结果的未被认识到的关联，乃是作为命运或必然性。

en: The connection of action and outcomes determined by principles of reason, the purposive becoming of world events and of the fates of individuals, is providence.
Faith in it is a moral faith.
zh: 行动与结果之间受理性原则规定的关联，即世界事件与单个人命运之合目的生成，就是护佑。
对护佑的信仰是一种道德的信仰。

en: Moral faith contains, first, absolute laws and purposes.89) )
zh: 道德的信仰首先包含着绝对的法则与目的。89) )

en: As regards the first, one side of nature is external purposiveness; natural things are so constituted that they do not completely contain their concept in their existence, but for this belong, first, several particularly existing things and, on the whole, totality, in which alone the absolute is expressed.
zh: 关于第一点，自然的一个方面就是外在的合目的性：自然物是这样构成的，即它们并未在自己的存在中完整地包含着自己的概念，而要做到这一点，首先须有若干特殊存在着的事物，一般地则须有总体性，只有在总体性中，绝对者才被表达出来。

en: But nature in its truth as divine image, insofar as the absoluteness is contained in them, is the inner self-contained purposiveness of natural things – their vitality.
zh: 然而自然作为神圣摹本、在其真理中——就绝对性包含在自然物之中而言——就是自然物的内在的、自身具足的合目的性——它们的生机。

en: (Mechanical, dead, depressed way of considering,) all life, – full of life; – life-bearing earth, sea, sun, – nature-gods – higher kinship with spirit than with its contingencies, particulars – Isis – nearer kinship than Greek prophecies matter living; – divine, but therefore not God.
Rumour of life in dead things, forces given, things and forces separated – whether it is true that they have this.
But the content, the matter, nothing true.
zh: （机械的、死寂的、压抑的观看方式，）一切都是生命，——充满了生命；——生育生命的大地、海洋、太阳，——自然诸神——同精神的亲属关系高过同精神的偶然性、个别性的亲属关系——伊西斯——比希腊的神谕预言更切近的亲属关系——物质是有生命的；——是神圣的，但并不因此就是上帝。
死物中有生命的喧传，力量被给予，事物与力量分开——它们是否真有这些，这是否是真实的。
但内容、事情本身，却没有任何真实的东西。

en: Vitality is, more precisely, the presentation of spirit, because it is the concept to which reality is adequate, and which in its externality is the whole concept; – but it is also only a natural presentation of the same and points beyond itself, because the concept as life is not at the same time present in the form of the concept free from its externality.
zh: 生机更确切地说就是精神的表现，因为精神是那个其实在性与之相适合的概念，而这概念在其外在性中就是整个概念；——但它也只是精神在自然中的表现，并且指向自身之外，因为概念作为生命，并不同时以概念的形式摆脱了自己的外在性而存在。

en: Proofs of the determinate being of God from nature; – they prove only life or divinity – points beyond itself.
zh: 从自然出发对上帝定在的证明；——它们证明的只是生命或神性——指向自身之外。

en: The connection of self-conscious action and its outcomes, in the history of the individual human being or in world history, represented without concept – this is faith in fate or in necessity.
zh: 有自我意识的行动及其结果的关联，在单个个人的历史中或在世界历史中，当作无概念的东西来表象，这就是对命运或对必然性的信仰。

en: But that a purpose lies at the basis of history – this is contained in faith in providence.90)
zh: 但是历史有一个目的作为基础——这就包含在对护佑的信仰中。90)

en: Existence, determinate being, has infinite value – whether the individual perishes, or his ethical purpose. – abstract identity with oneself. The dignity of spiritual nature; I let it be pleasing to me; identity with oneself; unbowed, without consolation; [the] vulgar consolation demands compensation; that withdrawal into the freedom of oneself [belongs only to] the sublime ethical natures of the ancients, [they] feel pain in a human way, – not the empty, cold magnanimity, the sacrifice of the novels; – the chorus constitutes the middle, the quiet reflection.
Being as the objective; subjective reflection for the most part suspended.

Completion through itself; – without all subjective purposes, reflection, and ought – content of the chorus: for whom is this intuition, reflection of the whole? and the external circumstances of the course of the world? …
[?] modern, in general the moral nature.
zh: 存在、定在具有无限的价值——不论个体是否毁灭，或者他的伦理目的是否毁灭。——同自身的抽象同一；精神本性的尊严；我甘愿承受；同自身的同一；不屈不挠，无需慰藉；［庸俗的］慰藉要求补偿，那种退回自身之自由中［只属于］古代人的崇高的伦理本性，［他们］以人的方式感受痛苦，——而不是小说中空虚、冷酷的宽宏大量、牺牲；——歌队构成中项，构成平静的反思。
存在作为客观的东西；主观的反思大体上已被扬弃。
通过自身的补足；——不带任何主观的目的、反思与应然——歌队的内容：这种直观、对整体的反思、以及世事的进程的外在情境，是为谁而有的？……
[?] 近代的、总之是道德的本性。

71.en: A Leaf on the Doctrine of Spirit91)
71.zh: 论精神学说的一个页面91)

en: Our ordinary knowledge represents only the object that it knows, but not at the same time itself, namely knowledge itself; yet the whole, what is present in knowledge, is not only the object but also the I that knows, and the relation of me and of the object to one another, consciousness.
zh: 我们通常的知识只表象它所知道的对象，却不同时表象它自身，即知识本身；然而在知识中现成的整体，不仅仅是对象，而且还有知道着的我，以及我与对象彼此之间的关系，即意识。

en: The conscious spirit, thought more determinately, is appearing.
zh: 有意识的精神，更确切地思考，就是显现着。

en: But spirit according to its self-activity within itself and in relation to itself is considered in the proper doctrine of spirit.
zh: 但精神就其在其自身之内的自活动以及对其自身的关系而言，则是在本来意义上的精神学说中加以考察的。

en: In the fact that I have certainty lies only the pure positive relation of the object to me; but the same object is at the same time distinguished from me; or the subject is thus also unequal to the object; hence certainty as such is not yet truth; for truth is the agreement of my knowledge with the object.
zh: 在我有确定性这一点中，只包含对象对我之纯粹的肯定关系；但同一个对象同时又同我相区别；或者说，主体因此也同客体不相等；因此确定性作为这样的东西还不是真理；因为真理是我的知识同对象的相合。

en: Space and time are the abstract determinate being, the pure sensory form or pure intuiting.
Space [is] the pure form as the general, tranquil indifference of being-outside-one-another in general; time the pure form as being-outside-oneself pure being-within-itself, or negative unity.94)
zh: 空间与时间是抽象的定在，是纯粹的感性形式或纯粹的直观活动。
空间［是］作为一般的、平静地对一切在外存在之漠不相干性的纯粹形式；时间则是作为在外存在着的纯粹自身内存在、或者说否定性统一的纯粹形式。94)

en: Their boundlessness or infinity consists in the abstract continuity of their being-outside-one-another.
zh: 它们的无边无际或无限，在于其在外存在之抽象的连续性。

en: But as ideas they have determinations within themselves which present the concept.
zh: 但作为观念，它们在自身内部有一些呈现概念的规定。

en: These determinations are the inner moments or the dimensions of space and time.
zh: 这些规定就是空间与时间的内在环节或维度。

en: The dimensions of universal space are its inner distinctions, not of a quantitative but of a qualitative kind, at the same time not outside one another, but where one is, there the other is.
They are indeed distinct as the First, the Other, and the Third, but this distinction is an empty universal distinction in general.
These moments have no determinacy against one another in themselves.
Such are the dimensions of length, breadth, and height, which are distinguished only in relation to a third, something determinate in itself.
zh: 普遍空间的诸维度是它的内在差别，不是数量上的而是性质上的差别，同时也不是彼此外在的，而是一个在的地方，另一个也在那里。
它们固然作为第一者、他者、第三而有差别，但这差别无非是空洞的、一般的差别。
这些环节在它们自身之中没有彼此对立的规定性。
属于这样的，就是长度、宽度、高度的维度，它们只是相对于第三个、一个自身确定的东西才被区分开。

en: Only through the positing of an absolute determinacy do these distinctions enter into a negative relation, determined against one another.

The point, the absolute negation in space, entering into a positive relation with it, moves itself into the line, this into the surface, which at the same time as the third dimension is an enclosing surface and produces space as totality, yet one with a boundary, as a bounded space.
zh: 只有通过设定一个绝对的规定，这些差别才进入一个否定的、彼此规定的关系。
点，即空间中的绝对否定，同空间进入肯定的关系，就运动为线，线运动为面，面同时作为第三维度是包裹起来的面，并把空间建立为总体性，但带有界限，亦即作为有界限的空间。

94.en: 11. Appendix: Reports by Hegel on His Subjects of Instruction
94.zh: 11. 附录：黑格尔关于其教学科目的报告

en: From the printed gymnasium programs
zh: 摘自印行的文科中学学年报告

97.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, four hours weekly. Teacher: Professor and Rector Hegel95)
97.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周四小时。执教者：教授兼校长黑格尔95)

en: The task of this class herein was an introduction into the knowledge of the philosophical connection of the sciences; logic, namely including what is otherwise called ontology or also transcendental logic, was treated most at length.
zh: 这个班级在这一科目上的内容，是导引出对各门科学之哲学关联的知识；其中讲得最详尽的是逻辑学，即包括通常所谓的本体论或先验逻辑学在内的逻辑学。

en: Algebra was presented and practiced from the general modes of calculation through proportions, progressions, and logarithms up to and including equations of the second degree.
On account of the brevity of this first year of study, geometry could only be carried as far as the third book of Euclid.
zh: 代数从一般的运算法讲起并加以练习，经过比例、级数与对数，直到包括二次方程为止。
由于这第一个学年为时短促，几何学只能讲到欧几里得的第三卷。

en: One began with the doctrine of consciousness and its shapes, then advanced to the categories and then to the antinomies relating to them and their dialectic, after which one proceeded to the proper logic.
zh: 从意识学说及其诸形态开始，然后进展到范畴，再进展到与之相关的二律背反及其辩证法，此后才进到本来意义上的逻辑学。

en: First logic was treated in its full extent, however with the exclusion of objective or transcendental logic; then of the philosophical encyclopedia the part which comprehends the natural sciences within itself.
zh: 首先论及逻辑学的全部广度，但排除了客观逻辑学或先验逻辑学；然后是哲学百科全书中把自然科学包含在自身内的那一部分。

108.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, four hours weekly
108.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周四小时

en: The doctrine of the stages of consciousness, then the theoretical part of psychology, namely the doctrine of intelligence, was treated according to dictated paragraphs, in such a way that the pupils were guided to apprehend abstract representations and to receive a first concept of a systematic progress of a science.
zh: 关于意识的诸阶段的学说，接着是心理学的理论部分，即理智学说，都依照口授的段落来讲授，并借此引导学生去把握抽象的表象，获得关于一门科学之系统进展的最初概念。

111.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, four hours weekly
111.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周四小时

en: Rector Hegel first presented the general concepts of logic; then he passed over to the doctrines of right, of duties, and of religion, of which likewise the first basic concepts were treated.
zh: 校长黑格尔首先讲授逻辑学的一般概念；然后转到法权学说、义务学说与宗教学说，同样也论及了它们的最初基本概念。

114.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, four hours weekly
114.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周四小时

en: The philosophical encyclopedia was presented in systematic order, and the basic concepts of the sciences of nature and of spirit were discussed.
zh: 哲学百科全书按系统次序讲授，并对自然科学与精神科学的基本概念作了阐明。

117.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, four hours weekly
117.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周四小时

en: This year, in this class of a two-year course, universal logic was treated; the main consideration, aside from the content, as regards the manner of treatment, was to initiate the students into abstract thinking, whereby, on the occasion of the dialectical – whose earlier shape they had been made acquainted with through the Kantian antinomies – beginnings of speculative thinking were also connected.
zh: 这一学年，在这一两年学程的班级里论及的是普遍逻辑学；除内容外，处理方式上的主要着眼点是，把学生引导进抽象思维，而借此，在涉及辩证法之际——通过康德的二律背反，他们已经熟悉了它的先前形态——也连带有了思辨思维的开端。

120.en: Doctrines of Right, Morality, and Religion, four hours weekly
120.zh: 法权学说、道德学说与宗教学说，每周四小时

en: Since the content of these doctrines could be presumed known to the pupils through the religious instruction previously received, one was able to advance to the concepts on which they rest and from which the particular determinations are derived; the instruction thereby became at the same time the beginning of an exercise in abstract thinking.
zh: 由于这些学说的内容，就学生而言，可以凭着他们先前所领受的宗教课而假定为他们已知，故得进而研究它们所依据、特殊诸规定由之引申而出的诸概念；这一授课由此同时成了抽象思维练习的开端。

123.zh: 哲学百科全书，每周三小时

en: After a repetition of logic, the basic concepts of the particular sciences were presented in systematic order.
zh: 在重复逻辑学之后，便按系统次序讲授了诸特殊科学的基本概念。

125.en: Doctrine of Religion, one hour weekly
125.zh: 宗教学说，每周一个小时

en: Jointly with the Middle Class
zh: 同中年级一起上

128.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, three hours weekly
128.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周三小时

en: This year psychology was presented, which is treated alternately with logic in the two years of this class’s course; first the doctrine of consciousness according to its main stages; then the proper doctrine of the activities of spirit.
zh: 这一年讲授的是心理学——它在这一班级两年的学程中与逻辑学交替讲授——；先是按照意识的主要诸阶段讲意识学说；然后是本来意义上的精神行动学说。

130.en: Doctrine of Religion, one hour weekly
130.zh: 宗教学说，每周一个小时

en: After the concept of religion and of God, the usual proofs of the determinate being of God were presented, the Kantian critique of them was assessed, and from there the right standpoint was shown for the grounding of religion and for the nearer cognition of the nature of God.
zh: 继宗教与上帝的概念之后，便讲授了关于上帝定在的通常诸证明，评判了康德对这些证明的批判，并从那里指出了为宗教奠基以及更切近地认识上帝本性的正确立足点。

133.en: Doctrines of Right, Duties, and Religion, four hours weekly
133.zh: 法权学说、义务学说与宗教学说，每周四小时

en: The basic concepts were treated according to short dictations, these were explained, and the pupils were given guidance in putting the essential content of the explanations on paper.
zh: 基本概念依照简短的口授讲授，这些口授得到了诠释，学生则受到指导，把诠释中的主要内容写成文字。

136.zh: 哲学百科全书，每周三小时

en: Of the three parts of philosophical science, logic, the philosophy of nature, and the philosophy of spirit, longer stay was made at the second, the philosophy of nature, and the basic concepts of its particular sciences were stated, while the first and third were gone through by way of repetition, because they had already occurred in the Middle Class.
zh: 在哲学科学的三个部分——逻辑学、自然哲学与精神哲学——之中，在第二部分即自然哲学处停留较久，并给出其各门特殊科学的基本概念；第一和第三部分则按复习方式过了一遍，因为它们已在中年级讲过了。

138.en: Doctrine of Religion, one hour weekly
138.zh: 宗教学说，每周一个小时

en: This year, from the concept of God one advanced to the cognition of his revelation in natural and spiritual things.
zh: 这一年，从上帝概念前进到对上帝在自然事物与精神事物中之启示的认识。

141.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, three hours weekly
141.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周三小时

en: This year logic was presented; the first two parts, the doctrine of being and the doctrine of essence, or the categories and the reflexive determinations, were gone through more briefly according to their main concepts, and longest of all at the third part, the doctrine of the concept.
zh: 这一年讲授的是逻辑学；前两部分，即存在学说与本质学说，或者说范畴与反思规定，只按其主要概念简要地过了一遍，停留最久的是第三部分，即概念学说。

143.en: Doctrine of Religion, one hour weekly
143.zh: 宗教学说，每周一个小时

en: Jointly with the Upper Class.
zh: 同高年级一起上。

146.en: Doctrines of Right, Duties, and Religion, four hours weekly
146.zh: 法权学说、义务学说与宗教学说，每周四小时

en: The legal and moral basic concepts were treated according to dictations, and the explanations given were written down under the guidance of the teacher.
zh: 有关法权与道德的基本概念依照口授来讲授，所作的诠释则在教师的指导下写成文字。

149.zh: 哲学百科全书，每周三小时

en: The survey over the whole of the sciences was given in such a way that the systematic connection was to become evident, and the concepts which make up the ground of the particular sciences were explained.
zh: 对科学整体的概览是按照这样的方式给出的：要使系统的关联昭然可见，并对那些构成诸特殊科学的根据的那些概念加以诠释。

151.en: Doctrine of Religion, one hour weekly
151.zh: 宗教学说，每周一个小时

en: The doctrine of the familiar proofs of the determinate being of God was gone through, and these were stated partly in the form in which they had usually been set up, partly their higher meaning was demonstrated, whereby they are established as scientifically-philosophical proofs.
zh: 论及关于上帝定在的众所周知的诸证明：一部分按这些证明通常被提出的形式加以陈述，一部分则指出它们的更高意义，凭借这种意义它们才提升为科学—哲学的证明。

154.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, three hours weekly
154.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周三小时

en: Psychology was presented in such a way that first, in the phenomenology of spirit, the basic stages of consciousness were pointed out, then, in the proper doctrine of spirit, the essential activities of spirit were derived and explained.
zh: 心理学的讲授方式是：首先在《精神现象学》中指出意识的诸基本阶段，然后在本来意义上的精神学说中推导出并诠释精神的本质的行动。

en: Jointly with the Upper Class
zh: 同高年级一起上

159.en: Doctrines of Right, Duties, and Religion, four hours weekly
159.zh: 法权学说、义务学说与宗教学说，每周四小时

en: The basic determinations of right and of morality were treated according to dictations, and the presented explanations were written down under the guidance of the teacher.
zh: 关于法权与道德的基本规定依照口授来讲授，所讲授的诠释则在教师的指导下写成文字。

162.zh: 哲学百科全书，每周三小时

en: First the basic concepts of the universal objects into which the natural universe branches out were considered, and hereupon the main content of the science of spirit; at the aesthetic part of the latter the treatment lingered longer.
zh: 首先考察的是：自然宇宙分枝于其中的那些一般对象的基本概念，随后是精神科学的主要内容；对后者的美学部分停留较久。

164.en: Doctrine of Religion, one hour weekly
164.zh: 宗教学说，每周一个小时

en: After a repetition and completion of the proofs of the determinate being of God, which were represented as different stages of the rational way of knowing his concept, one passed over to the consideration of the extent to which this same cognition relates to intuition and experience.
zh: 在对上帝定在的证明加以重复和补足之后——这些证明被表象为对上帝的概念进行理性认识的诸不同阶段——进而考察这种认识对直观与经验的关系如何。

167.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, three hours weekly
167.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周三小时

en: This year logic was presented, and the basic concepts of its three parts, the doctrine of being, the doctrine of essence, and the doctrine of the concept, were explained according to dictations.
zh: 这一年讲授的是逻辑学，并依照口授对其三个部分——存在学说、本质学说、概念学说——的基本概念作了诠释。

en: Jointly with the Upper Class
zh: 同高年级一起上

172.en: Doctrines of Right, Duties, and Religion, four hours weekly
172.zh: 法权学说、义务学说与宗教学说，每周四小时

en: The basic determinations of right and of morality were treated according to dictations, and the presented explanations were written down under the guidance of the teacher.
zh: 关于法权与道德的基本规定依照口授来讲授，所讲授的诠释则在教师的指导下写成文字。

175.zh: 哲学百科全书，每周三小时

en: The survey over the whole of the sciences was given in such a way that the systematic connection was to become evident, and the concepts which make up the foundations of the particular sciences were explained.
zh: 对科学整体的概览是按照这样的方式给出的：要使系统的关联昭然可见，并对那些构成诸特殊科学的根据的那些概念加以诠释。

177.en: Doctrine of Religion, one hour weekly
177.zh: 宗教学说，每周一个小时

en: This year the Christian doctrine of faith was gone through, according to the Athanasian creed.
zh: 这一年依据亚他那修信经通讲了基督教信理。

180.en: Philosophical Preparatory Sciences, three hours weekly
180.zh: 哲学预备学科，每周三小时

en: This year psychology was presented, and the beginning was made from the phenomenology of spirit together with the stages of consciousness, then, in the proper doctrine of spirit, its essential activities were derived and explained.
zh: 这一年讲授的是心理学，以《精神现象学》连同意识的诸阶段为开端，然后在本来意义上的精神学说中推导出并诠释精神的本质的行动。

en: Jointly with the Upper Class
zh: 同高年级一起上

185.en: Doctrine of Right, four hours weekly

en: This year the basic determinations of right were treated according to dictations, and the presented explanations were written down under the guidance of the teacher.
zh: 这一年关于法权的基本规定依照口授来讲授，所讲授的诠释则在教师的指导下写成文字。

188.en: 1. Oration to his predecessor in office Rector Schenk on 10 July 180996)
188.zh: 1. 致前任校长申克的演辞，1809年7月10日96)

en: Noble, venerable old man!
zh: 高尚的、令人崇敬的长者！

en: This assembly, at once so brilliant and so worthy of esteem, which in celebrating the fifty-year merit of its teacher does it honor, has invited the teachers and pupils of the gymnasium establishment to this family festival, in order to be witnesses of a gratitude which is equally honorable for you, noble old man and highly esteemed colleague, its object, and for the assembly itself; in order to rejoice together with it at your good fortune in having reached so rare a goal and at the same time [one] of a career so worthily completed.

This society has likewise graciously acceded to my wish to be permitted, in its midst, where it has offered to the teacher the expression of the joy of former pupils, to speak to you, dearest colleague, also the congratulatory greeting of the fellowship of the teaching office.
zh: 这集会辉光焕彩而又令人肃然起敬，它在此庆祝自己的教师执教五十年之功并为之增荣；它邀请文科中学的全体师生参加这一家庭节日，为的是作一种感激之情的见证——这种感激对您，高尚的长者、深受敬重的同僚，作为它的对象，同对集会本身一样，都是光荣的；为的是同集会一起，为您的幸运，已达到这样罕见的目标，且兼为一段配得上其尊严的圆满生涯，而一同庆幸。
此社团亦已欣然接纳我的请求，容我在其聚会之中——它在那里向教师献上昔日学生欢悦的表达——向您，最亲爱的同僚，也吐露同为执教同仁的祝贺之辞。

en: O the beautiful hour that unites us here, O the rich moment! rich in recollections of the past, rich in happy feelings of the present, also rich in blessing for the future; poor in wishes, for how little is it that remains to be wished for you, happy old man, and for us for you, since through divine goodness and through yourself you have attained what is most desirable, namely this old age crowned with merit and virtue and endowed with cheerfulness and health of soul and body, since the present festival still adds the recognition of this virtue and the honour of this merit and, as it were, unites them in one cup of noblest enjoyment.
zh: 哦，把我们联结在此的美好时辰！哦，这丰盈的时刻！对过去的回忆何其丰盈，对当前的幸福感觉何其丰盈，对未来的福佑又何其丰饶；在心愿上却是贫乏的——幸福的长者，因为留给您、留给我们替您去愿望的东西竟是那样少，既然您已凭着神的恩惠、凭着您自身，达乎最可愿望的东西，即这以功业与美德加冕、以灵魂与身体的健康和爽朗之气贯注的老年，既然眼前的盛典还添上对这一德行的认可与这一功业的尊荣，并仿佛把它们汇于一盏最醇美的享受之杯。

en: The teacher, when he has sown the seed of cognition in his vocation, steps back from his work; if even some of what was sown found no soil conducive to growth, he is nevertheless upon the whole certain of the effect and the success, on account of the spiritual, on account of the higher power that lies in the gift bestowed; he may rejoice within himself at the thought of the seed that will have sprung up; but seldom does the fortune fall to his lot to survey the field of harvests all at once and to enjoy his labor in such a total view.
zh: 教师在自己的职务上播下认识的种子之后，便从他的劳作旁退开；即使所播的一部分不曾遇到有助生长的土壤，他仍就整体而言对效果与成功确信不疑，为了那精神的缘故，为了那置于所赠之礼物中的较高力量的缘故；他可以自慰于这样一个思想：那种子将会破土而出；然而很少有这种幸运落到他身上，使他得以一并俯瞰那结满穗粒的田野，在如此整体的观照中享受他的劳作。

en: You, esteemed colleague, this society has prepared for you this rare enjoyment.

The circle that stands gathered around you consists of a great number of the most respectable men of this city, youths, men, even old men among them who transport themselves back into the times of their youth, into the times of hopeful presagings of world and life, which are also the time of the years of learning that prepare for the world and life and lead into them.
These men recall their former destination of having been pupils, are gathered here under this name, and confess that they are honored by it.
zh: 可敬的同僚，这社团为您预备了这一罕见的享受。
环立于您四周的人群，由本城中众多最可敬的人物组成，其中有少年，有成人，也有老人，他们返回到自身青春的时光，返回到对世界与生命怀有希望之先见的时光，那同时也是求学的岁月，是为世界与生命作准备、并引人进入其中的岁月。
这些人追忆自己昔日为学生这一职分，以这一名分聚会在此，并承认他们以此名分为荣。

en: They bring you their thanks, to you their old teacher, and not only that same thanks which they already paid you earlier, but also a second one which wells up from the ripened insight of the man experienced in life.

Comprehending in the years of learning, youth already recognizes with joy how, with instruction, new presentations, concepts, truths dawn in its spirit; it thanksfully perceives this stepwise enlargement of its horizon, this unsealing of the content and sense of natural and spiritual life as yet only divined.
But the man who has gone through experience of life appraises more completely the education acquired, the skills, and the principles implanted.

If the impetuously pressing-on striving of youth can become impatient of the extensive arrangements and preparations of the school for admission into the world, if the abstract doctrines of science seem to stand out of proportion to the concrete freshness of young fullness of life, then the man, by contrast, has recognized what is only dream and gleam of life and what is its truth; he has experienced that it is the treasures of ancient wisdom planted early in the heart which endure with us amid all change of conditions, strengthen and carry us; he has experienced how great the worth of education as such is, so great that a man of old97) might say that the difference of the educated man from the uneducated is as great as the difference of the human being as such from the stone.
zh: 他们向您呈上感恩，向您这位昔日的教师，而且不只是您早先已经献上的那同一份感恩，还有第二份，它从饱经世故的成熟洞见中涌出。
在求学的年代里即已有所理解，青年便怀着喜悦认出：随着教诲，怎样的新表象、新概念、新真理在其精神中破晓；它感恩地察觉到其眼界这种循阶段的扩展，察觉到那自然生命与精神生命的内容和意义、先前只是朦胧预感的东西，如今怎样被打开封印。
但是历尽了人世经验的人，才对所获得的教养、技能和被移植进来的原理作更完整的估量。

如果青年那急于向前推进的追求，会对学校为进入世界而作的庞大铺陈和准备感到不耐烦，如果科学的抽象学说似乎同年轻生命之具体的丰满不相称，那么人到了成年反过来却已认出：什么是生活的梦幻与微光、什么是生活的真理；他体验到，正是早早移植进心中的古代智慧的珍宝，才在同我们一道经受境遇的一切变迁时持存不倒、支撑我们、托举我们；他体验到教养本身的价值何等巨大，巨大到古代的贤人97)简直要说：受过教养的人同未受教养的人之间的差别，一如人同石头之间的差别。

en: To the teaching estate is entrusted the treasure of education, of cognitions and truths on which all past ages have worked, to preserve it and hand it down to posterity.

The teacher is to regard himself as the preserver and priest of this holy light, so that it be not extinguished and humanity not sink back into the night of ancient barbarism. – This transmission must on the one hand take place with faithful effort, but at the same time the letter becomes truly fruitful only through the teacher’s own sense and spirit.
zh: 教职等级受嘱托着教养、知识与真理的宝藏，一切过往的世纪都在其上施了劳作，以便把它保存下来并传给后代。
教师应当把自己看作这神圣之光的守护者和祭司，使它不致熄灭，使人类不致退回古代野蛮状态的黑夜里去。——这一传承一方面必须凭忠实的努力来进行，但同时，文字只有经过教师自己的意义与精神，才变得真正硕果累累。

en: You, noble teacher, have not merely reflected this light back like a mirror, as a dead tool that has no own focal point within itself, but you have nourished it by the vigorous oil of your own spirit into a warming flame.
You have handed on the wisdom otherwise dead, arrayed with your experience, enriched by your heart, ensouled and made alive by your soul.
zh: 您，高尚的教师，并不只是像一面镜子那样把这光反射回来，作为一件自身之内没有自己焦点的死工具，而是以您自己精神的健旺之油，把它养成为暖人的火焰。
您把本是死气沉沉的智慧传递出来，让它披上您的经验，由您的心灵加以丰富，并被您的灵魂注入生气而活了起来。

en: It is this indwelling soul of the teacher that constitutes the efficacy of his instruction.

You, most excellent teacher, have set up for us, your fellow members in the school estate, a great pattern in this regard, which we revere with esteem and after which, emulating it, we seek to draw near.
In whatever field it may be, the distinguished man becomes an influential example; he remains an image hovering with effect in the mind of those who belong to the same estate.

You received me, your immediate successor, at my entrance into my office not only with heartfelt benevolence, but your sight also circumscribed for me the [still for me] indeterminate character of the relations new to me.

Your image has said to me: thus shall I become as a schoolman, thus shall I be; your example has pronounced to me the sense of my vocation, clearer than inner resolutions, livelier than written instructions.
zh: 正是这内居的教师灵魂，构成了他授课的实效。
您，卓越的教师，在这点上为我们——您在教职中的同仁——树立了一个伟大的范型，我们怀着敬意尊崇它，并努力追慕它、向它靠拢。
无论在哪一门领域，出色的人物都会成为有影响力的榜样；他是一幅意象，在归属同一等级的人心中有效地留存徘徊。
您接待了我，您的直接继任者，在我到任之时不仅有衷心的善意，而且您的风姿也为我描画出那些对我尚属陌生的关系之［对我还是］未定的性格。
您的形象向我说了话：我应当这样成为一位教职中人，我应当这样立身；您的榜样为我宣示了我职务的意义，比内心的立志更清晰，比书面的训示更生动。

en: You have still greeted the new school establishment which this city owes to the sublime care of our king for public education, in that you yourself at this change experienced the grace of his Majesty and at last found the so well-deserved rest.

Who could more worthily close the older establishment which Melanchthon opened than you? – Who was more capable of showing that, if the influence of institutions is powerful, the spirit of men is still more powerful and the deficiency of the former can be replaced and overcome by the latter?

If the need of an improvement of the old establishment was generally recognized, then your personality as well as that of your co-workers made this need less conspicuous, and it is a joy for the new establishment to be able to be grateful to the government without mingling any other personal consideration than this: that we may not prove unworthy of such predecessors, and that we, as we attached ourselves to the establishments formerly existing through the community of purpose amid the difference of means, were also linked to them through the bond of personal esteem.
zh: 这城市把我校新的建制归功于吾王对公共教育那种崇高的关切，而您还亲见并问候了它，因为您自己在这场变革之中领受了陛下之恩宠，终于得到了如此当之无愧的清静。
还有谁能比您更配得上为那所由梅兰希开办的老学校举行合上的典礼？——又有谁更能表明：如果诸设施的影响是强大的，人的精神则更为强大，而前者的不足可以由后者来补足、被后者所克服？
如果说旧建制需要改良这一点普遍得到承认，那么您本人以及您各位同事的人格，就使这种需要显得不那么刺眼了；而新建制能够不对政府感恩之外再掺杂任何个人的考虑，只是一种考虑：我们但愿不至有辱这样的先贤；并且我们既然在共同目的之下、尽管手段相异，而同既往存在的建制相衔接，也就通过人格敬重之纽带同它们相连接——这是新建制的幸事。

en: Besides a great exemplar we owe to your merit also that encouragement which lies for ourselves in today’s solemnity, in this public testimony which this assembly so worthy of esteem renders of the merit of a teacher who faithfully fulfilled his calling; for we are permitted, in the personal honour which is the content of this festival, also to recognize with gratitude the honour that thereby befalls our profession as such.

It is refreshing for us to be active in a city where the quiet life of the school estate is neither overlooked amid more brilliant and more resounding appearances, nor forgotten above the pressure of the times and of greater interests; in a city where quiet civic virtue, where still the noble German disposition, faithful in the small as in the great, is honestly preserved and nourished, and honest efforts, even if inconspicuous like those of the school estate, are valued.
zh: 除了一个伟大的典范之外，您的功绩还给了我们一种勉励，它就在今日的盛典之中、在我们自己这一边：这集会如此可敬，它公开为那忠实地尽了职守的教师的功绩作证；因为我们被允许，在这庆典内容所系的个人的尊荣之中，也感恩地认出同时及于我们整个职业的那份尊荣。
我们在这样一座城市里任职，令人神清气爽：教职生活的宁静，既不因更辉耀、更喧嚣的现象而被漠视，也不被时势的压力和更大的利害关系所湮没；在这城市里，宁静的市民德行，那依然尚存的、在小事上如在大事上一样忠诚的高尚德意志心性，得到诚笃的护持与滋养，而诚笃的努力，即便同教职的努力一样毫不足道，也同样受到珍视。

en: This youth here too sees its fathers, sees the men whom it has learned to esteem from other relations of life, remember its school years with joyful retrospection, bring thanks to its old teacher, attest how highly they rate the acquisition of science and cognition; it sees an example of the high lesson that honest fulfillment of one’s duties is recognized, and that also in noiseless virtues, in a life that counts no historical days, there lies unconditioned worth and pure blessedness.
zh: 这里的青年也看到自己的父辈，看到那些从生活的其他关系中赢得他们敬重的人们，怀着欣喜的回忆追念自己的求学岁月，向昔日的教师呈献感恩，证明他们把科学与认识的收获估价得多么高；它看到一个例证，表明这条崇高的教义：诚笃地履行自己的义务是要得到承认的，而在默默无闻的美德中，在一种不数有历史记载的日子的生命中，也存在着无条件的价值与纯粹的幸福。

en: So full of content is this hour for all of us; most full of content and most serious for him who grants it to us.
In it the past of his so long official activity calls itself again forth; the work of his life has set itself up before his gaze.
And what is the testimony which this his work here publicly renders?
This testimony is a universal and free homage, rendered by love, by gratitude, by trust, by veneration; an homage for which princes may envy you, noble old man.

Today’s day entitles us to pronounce you blessed; you yourself, to say to yourself: I am blessed! – An expression which man and old man will be so much the more loath to utter, of himself or of others, the more he has come to know the inner worth and then the changeful nature of all that is wont to be reckoned to happiness, and becomes so much the more incapable of it, the more the remembrance of deceived hopes, of sufferings, cares and tribulations has clouded the heart and made it inaccessible to joyous cheer and happy feelings.

But you, most excellent old man, at your side your highly esteemed wife who accompanied you on your way with love and solicitous care, surrounded by your family so worthy of esteem, encircled by the most deserved love and veneration of your own revered pupils and fellow citizens, attested by their testimony and by the testimony of your own conscience – may I pronounce you blessed without the reproach of a superficial judgment, without having to fear the Nemesis; you yourself [may] say the word of yourself: I am blessed! – Whatever remembrance of cares or pains may still remain, they have passed, and this Sabbath hour of celebrating repose may fully blot out their memory; as no tear of remorse mingles in, so may no tear of melancholy mingle into the tears of the joyful emotion of this day.
zh: 这一时辰对我们众人是何等内容充盈；而对其赐予我们这一刻的人来说，它最为内容充盈，也最为庄重。
在其中，他那漫长公职岁月的往昔重新召唤出来；他生命的功业显现在他的眼前。
而他的这一功业在此公开作出的见证又是什么呢？
这一见证是一种普遍而自由的致敬，由爱、由感恩、由信赖、由崇敬所呈献；一种连君王们也可以羡慕您的致敬，高尚的长者。
今日的日子使我们有权称您为有福；使您自己能够对自己说：我是幸福的！——一个人到了成年、到了老年，会越来越羞于说出这一表达，不论是说自己还是说别人，因为他越认识那内在的价值、继而认识到一切惯常被算作幸福之物的变幻无常的本性，他就越无福当此，因为对被骗的希望、对苦难、烦忧与忧伤的回忆，已使心灵蒙翳，使它无法领受开朗的欣悦与幸福的感觉。

但是您，卓越绝伦的长者，在您身旁是您深受敬重的夫人，她以爱和操劳伴随您走上您的路程，您被您可敬的家人所环绕，被您自己受敬重的学生与同胞那最当之无愧的爱戴与崇敬所围绕，由他们的见证、也由您自己良心的见证加以证实——请允许我称您为有福，而无浅薄判断之讥，而无涅墨西斯之惧；您自己［也敢于］对自己说出这句话：我是幸福的！——无论还留下什么对烦忧或痛苦的回忆，它们都过去了，而这庆祝安宁的安息日时辰，会把它们的记忆完全涂抹净尽；正如同没有悔恨之泪掺杂进来，今日喜悦感动的泪水之中，也不要掺杂任何怅惘之泪。

en: So we rejoice in the evening sun which has accomplished its day’s work with its ripening effect, and still lingers to cast its greeting of farewell upon the grateful earth, now as a quiet image of the remembrance of its mighty radiation, shining in mild serenity –
zh: 就这样，我们欣喜于落日：它以催熟万物的效果，完成了自己的日间之功，却仍流连着，把辞别的问候投向感恩的大地，此时已化为展示其力之辐射之回忆的宁静意象，在温和的明朗中放光——

en: so this beautiful moment is the silver outlook of your life, which embraces the blessed work of fifty years, the love of hundreds, the esteem of all.
This moment will leave an unforgettable after-resound within us; and for you, noble old man, of whom it is the content, may it for your remaining years be of gladdening and beneficent strengthening.
So may you long still sojourn among us, long still enjoy the love of your family happy in you, our grateful veneration and friendship, and your own heart.
zh: 同样，这美好的时刻就是您生命的银辉返照，它包蕴着五十年的福祉之功、数百人的爱戴、众人的敬重。
这一时刻将在我们心中留下不可磨灭的回响；而对您——高尚的长者，它就是您的内容——愿它在您余下的岁月里成为振奋心神、有益身心的滋补。
愿您长久地继续留居在我们中间，长久地享受在您之中得福的家人的爱、我们感恩的崇敬与友谊，以及您自己的心灵。

204.en: 2. Oration at the Close of the School Year on 29 September 180999)

en: By most gracious commands I am directed, at the solemn distribution of prizes which the most high government destines as rewards and still more as encouragement for the pupils who distinguish themselves by their progress, to present in a public oration the history of the gymnasium establishment in the year gone by and to touch upon what may be purposeful to say concerning the relation of the public to it.

However reverently I have to fulfill this duty, so much does the invitation to it lie in the very nature of the subject and content which is a series of royal benefactions or their effects, and whose presentation contains the expression of the deepest gratitude for the same – a gratitude which we render in community with the public to the sublime care of the government for the public educational establishments. – There are two branches of state administration for whose good arrangement peoples are wont to be most grateful, good administration of justice and good educational institutions; for of no branch does the private man overlook and feel the advantages and effects so immediately, near, and singly as of those branches, one of which concerns his property in general, the other however his dearest property, his children.
zh: 奉至仁的命令，我受谕：在隆重的奖品颁授之际——至高的政府把这些奖品拨给以学业进步见长的学生，作为报偿，更作为勉励——用一篇公开演辞陈述文科中学在本学年的历史，并论及公众同本校之关系上可以说的话。

我纵是最为恭谨地履行这一义务，而应作之事也愈益在于事情与内容自身的本性：它就是王一系列的恩泽或这些恩泽的效果，对它的表述本身就含有对此最深切的感恩——我们同公众一道，向政府对公共教育机构那种崇高的关切呈献这一感恩。——国家行政有两个部门，人民惯常对之最为感戴，即良好的司法与良好的教育机构；因为论到哪一个部门，私家个人也不会像论到这两个部门那样，如此直接、如此切身、如此逐项地看出并感到其利处与效果，而这两个部门中，前者关乎他的一般财产，后者却关乎他最珍贵的财产，他的儿女。

en: This city has recognized the benefaction of a new school arrangement so much the more vividly, the greater and more generally felt the need of a change was.
zh: 本市对新学校建制之恩惠体会得愈为真切，正由于变革之需要原来愈大、感受愈普遍。

en: The new establishment had further the advantage of following upon old establishments subsisting for several centuries, and not upon something wholly new; thus there could attach to it the existing representation of a long duration, of something stable, and the meeting confidence was not disturbed by the counter-thought that the new arrangement might be something merely transient, experimental – a thought which particularly, when it [settles down] in the minds of those to whom the immediate execution is entrusted, is often even capable of actually degrading an arrangement to a mere experiment.
zh: 新建制还占另一个便宜：它所接续的是已存续数世纪之久的老建制，而不是全无依傍的新创；这样一来，长久绵远、恒久不移的现成表象就可以系到它身上，而迎上来的信任也不致被相反的思绪所扰，好像新建制或许只是权宜之计、试验之举似的——这种想法，尤其是在[盘踞]于受托直接执行者的人们心中时，甚至常常真的会把一项建制贬为纯粹的试验。

en: But an inner ground of confidence is that the new establishment, with an essential improvement and enlargement of the whole, has preserved the principle of the older one, and in this respect is only a continuation of the same.
And it is remarkable that this circumstance constitutes the characteristic and distinguished feature of the new arrangement.
zh: 但信赖还有一个更内在的根据：新建制在整体上作了本质的改良与扩充的同时，保持了旧建制的原理，就此而言它只是旧制之继续。
而值得注意的是，恰恰这一点构成了新建制的特征与优胜之处。

en: Since the study year which is ending is the first year, and the history of our establishment in it is the history of its origin, the thought of its whole plan and purpose lies too near for us to turn away from it already and to direct our attention to particular events in it.
Because the thing itself has just come to be, its substance still occupies curiosity and more reflective deliberation.

But the particulars are partly known from the public announcements; partly, as well as the further detail of what, how, and how many pupils have been taught this year, is contained in the printed list of pupils communicated to the public.

Permit me therefore, in the august presence of your Excellencies and of this assembly of high distinction, to hold to the principle of our institute and to lay before you some general thoughts on its relation, its basic features, and their sense, insofar as the distracting multiplicity of affairs which my office just at this moment brought with it permitted me to collect myself.
zh: 由于行将结束的学年就是第一个学年，而本校在这一年的历史就是它创办的历史，因此关于它整个计划与目的这一思想就在眼前，我们还不会从它转身，去注意其中的个别事件。
由于事情本身刚刚生成，它的实体就还吸引着好奇心和更深一层的思量。
至于细节，一部分已由公开的文告为人知晓；另一部分，连同更详尽的情形——本年在教什么、怎么教、教了多少学生——都载在印行并送给公众的学生名册里。
因此，请允许我在诸位阁下同这样尊贵的集会面前，紧扣我们学园的原理，就其关系、其纲纪与其意义陈述几点一般性的思想，尽管我职务恰在此时带来的纷至沓来的杂务，只容我如此匆匆收拾心得。

en: The spirit and purpose of our establishment is preparation for scholarly study, and indeed a preparation built upon the ground of the Greeks and Romans.
For several millennia this has been the soil on which all culture has stood, out of which it has sprung and with which it has been in constant connection.

Just as natural organizations, plants and animals, wrest themselves free of gravity, yet cannot leave this element of their being, so all art and science has grown out of that soil; and although it has also become independent within itself, it has not freed itself from the memory of that older education.
As Antaeus renewed his strength by contact with the mother earth, so every new ascent and reinvigoration of science and education has lifted itself into the light out of the return to antiquity.
zh: 我们学校的精神与目的，是为学术研习作准备，而的确是这样一种准备：它建立在希腊人与罗马人的根据之上。
几千年来，这是一切文化站立于其上的土壤，文化由它萌发，并始终同它保持着联系。
正如自然有机体、植物与动物，挣脱重力的羁绊，却不能离开属于它们本质的这一元素，一切艺术与科学也是这样从那种土壤里长成；它虽然也在自身中自立起来了，却没有把自己从对那更古教养的记忆中解放出来。
正如安泰俄斯靠同大地母亲的接触更新了自己的气力，科学与教养的每一次新的高扬与重振，也都是从回归古代中升到光里来的。

en: But however important the preservation of this soil is, just so essential is the alteration of the relation in which it formerly stood.

When insight into the insufficiency, the disadvantage of old principles and institutions in general enters, and therewith into the former purposes and means of education connected with them, then the thought which offers itself first on the surface is their complete elimination and abolition.

But the wisdom of the government, exalted above this help that seems easy, meets the need of the time in the truest way by setting the old into a new relation to the whole, and thereby preserving the essential in it as much as it changes and renews it.
zh: 但保持这种土壤固然重要，改变它从前所处的关系同样必不可少。
当人们看清楚了旧的原理与制度总的说来不敷需要、有所不利，并且连带看清了同它们联系在一起的旧时教养的宗旨与手段，那么浮在表面上首先映入眼帘的思想，就是把它们彻底取消、彻底废除。
然而政府的智慧高高超越这种看似轻易的补救，它以最真实的方式回应了时代的需要：它把旧者放进同整体的一个新的关系里，从而在改变并维新它的同时，同样也保存了它的本质性的东西。

en: I need only to recall in a few words the well-known position which learning the Latin language formerly had, that the same was not so much regarded as a moment of scholarly study, but constituted the most essential part of it, and was the only higher means of education held out to him who would not stay at the general, entirely elementary instruction; that for the acquisition of other cognitions useful for civic life or in and for themselves of worth, hardly any express arrangements had been made, but it was left in general to the occasion of acquiring that language whether and how much of them stuck by the way – that those cognitions were partly regarded as a special art, not at the same time as a means of education, and for the greatest part were wrapped up in that shell.
zh: 我只需寥寥数语提一提众所周知的情形，即从前学习拉丁文所处的地位：它与其说是学术研习的一个环节，不如说它本身构成了学术研习的最主要部分，是向那些不甘停留在一般而全然的初步教学之外的人所提供的唯一更高的教养手段；至于市民生活有用、或自在自为有价值的其他知识的获得，则几乎没有作任何专门的安排，大致全凭学习那门语言的际遇，看能顺带捞到多少——这些知识部分地被看作一种专门的技术，而不同时被看作教化的手段，其绝大部分被包裹在那外壳里。

en: The general voice rose against that Latin learning which had become unfortunate; above all the feeling rose that a people cannot be regarded as educated which cannot express all the treasures of science in its own language and move freely in it with any content.

This intimacy with which our own language belongs to us is lacking to the cognitions which we possess only in a foreign one; a partition wall separates them from us, one that does not let them be truly at home in the spirit.
zh: 众口一词，反对那已沦为祸害的拉丁文学习；尤其是有这样一种感觉高涨起来：一个民族，若不能把自己的语言当作表达科学的一切珍宝的工具、不能用它自由地应付任何内容，就不能被视为有教养的民族。
母语之归属我们那样亲密无间，而只在一种外国语中持有的知识，却缺少这种亲密；一堵隔墙把它们同我们分开，使它们不能在精神里真正落户安家。

en: This point of view, the faulty methods often sinking to a consistent mechanism, the neglected acquisition of many important cognitions of matters and of intellectual skills, has by degrees deposed the knowledge of the Latin language from its claim to be regarded as the principal science, and from its long-maintained dignity of being the universal and almost exclusive means of education.

It has ceased to be regarded as an end, and this intellectual occupation has instead had to see so-called subject matters, among them everyday, sensuous things incapable of furnishing any educational material, become mighty over it.

Without entering into these oppositions and their further determinations, their exaggerations or external collisions, let it suffice here that we rejoice in the wise relation which our most high government has established in this regard.
zh: 这一观点、缺陷百出以至于沦落为彻头彻尾的机械作用的方法、许多重要的实务知识与精神技能的荒疏——凡此种种，逐渐把拉丁语言的知识从它作为主要科学的要求权上、从它久经坚持的作为普遍而几乎排他的教养手段的尊位上废了下来。
它不再被当作目的，于是这一精神的行业就反过来眼睁睁看着所谓的事务、其中包括提供不出任何教养材料的日常感性东西，骑到了自己头上。
我们不必细究这些对立及其进一步的规定、它们的过火之处或外在的冲突，此处只需为至高的政府在这方面所规定的明智关系而欣悦就够了。

en: Firstly, through the perfection of the German elementary schools it has enlarged general civic education; by this means all are procured the means to learn what is essential for them as human beings and useful for their station; to those who hitherto lacked the better, it is hereby granted; but to those who, in order to obtain something better than the insufficient general instruction, could only reach for the named means of education, the same is made less necessary and replaced by more purposeful cognitions and skills. – This city too looks forward with expectation to the complete organization of this benefaction already demonstrated to the greatest part of the rest of the kingdom – a benefaction whose important consequences for the whole can scarcely be calculated.
zh: 第一，它通过德意志初等学校的完善，扩大了普遍的市民教养；由此为所有人开辟了门路，去学那作为人本质上的东西、对于其等级有用处的东西；向迄今无缘受用那更好者的人们，如今把它赐给他们；而向那些为了获得比不敷需要的一般教学更好的东西、只能去取用上述那一种教养手段的人们，则使那手段变得不那么不可或缺，而由更有意义的知识与技能来替代。——本市也翘首企盼着这一恩惠在组织上的全盘完成，它已经施及王国的其余大部分地区——这一恩惠之于全体的重大后果，几乎无法计算。

en: Secondly, the study of the sciences and the acquisition of higher intellectual and useful skills, in their independence of the old literature, in a sister establishment100) of its own has received its complete means.
zh: 第二，科学的研习以及较高的精神技能与实用技能的获得，既然已从旧文学中独立出来，也就在自有的一种姊妹学校100)里得到了完备的手段。

en: Thirdly and finally, the old study of languages is preserved.
It stands partly as before open to everyone as a higher means of education, partly however it has been fortified as a thorough basis of scholarly study.
Since it has now stepped in beside those means of education and scholarly ways, it has lost its exclusiveness and can have effaced the hatred against its former presumptions.
Thus placed on one side, it has so much more the right to demand that in its separation it be freely allowed to do its work, and remain further unmolested by alien, disturbing interferences.
zh: 第三，也是最后，古代语言的学习得到了保存。
它一部分一仍其旧，作为更高的教养手段向每一个人开放；一部分则被巩固为学术研习的彻底基础。
它既然如今站到那些教养手段与学术门类之旁，就失去了它的排他性，也就能消泯掉针对它昔日僭妄的愤恨。
如此退居一侧之后，它反而更有权利要求：在它自身分划之内自由地作它的工作，并且不再受那异质的、捣乱的干预之扰。

en: Through this separation and limitation it has received its truthful position and the possibility of all the more freely and completely developing itself.

The genuine mark of the freedom and strength of an organization consists in this, that the differentiated moments which it contains deepen themselves within themselves and make themselves into complete systems, drive their work beside one another without envy and fear and see one another driving it, and that all are again only parts of one great whole.
Only what perfects itself in its principle in separation becomes a consistent whole, that is, it becomes something; it acquires depth and the powerful possibility of versatility.
The anxiety and scrupulosity about one-sidedness as a rule belongs all too often to the weakness which is only capable of a versatile, inconsequent superficiality.
zh: 经由这种分划与限定，它得到了自己真实的地位，以及愈益自由而充分地发展自身的可能。
一个组织之自由与强力的真正标志在于：它内部诸有别的环节各自沉入自身之内、把自己做成完整的体系，在彼此旁边不忌不惧地各自经营、并眼看着彼此经营，而这一切又都只是一大整体的各部分。
唯有在分离中在自己的原理上臻于完善的东西，才成为前后一贯的整体，也就是说，成为某种实在的东西；它得到深度，得到多方面的强而有力的可能性。
对片面性的担心与顾虑，往往倒是属于那种软弱——它唯一能做到的，只是面面俱到而一无是处的肤浅。

en: If now the study of the old languages, as before, remains the foundation of scholarly education, it has also in this limitation been taken into very great requisition.
It seems a just demand that the culture, art, and science of a people should come to stand on its own feet.

Are we allowed to believe of the education of the newer world, of our enlightenment and the progress of all arts and sciences, that it has stood in for the buskins of the Greeks and Romans, that it has outgrown their old leading strings and can now stand on its own ground and soil?

The works of the ancients might always retain their greater or lesser estimated value, but they would have to retire into the row of memories, of learned idle curiosities, under the merely historical, which one may adopt or may not, but which would not have to constitute simply and categorically the foundation and the beginning of our higher cultivation of mind.
zh: 那么，古代语言之研习既一仍其旧地作为学术教养的基础，就同样在这限定之中被征调得十分厉害。
一个民族的文化、艺术与科学应当自己立起身来，这看上去像是一项正当的要求。
论到近世世界的教养、我们的启蒙以及一切艺术与科学的进步，我们岂能相信它们已经替希腊人与罗马人代劳过、已经挣脱了那根老的引绳，如今能够立足于自己的地面与土壤之上？
古人的著作尽可以保留或多或少的被估定的价值，但它们就该退入记忆的系列、退到学人游手好闲的珍奇之列、退到单纯史料的檐下——这些尽可收纳，也可不收纳，却断乎不能构成我们更高精神教养的基础与开端。

en: But if we concede that in general one has to proceed from the excellent, then for the higher study the literature of the Greeks, primarily, and then of the Romans, is and must remain the foundation.
The consummation and glory of these masterworks must be the intellectual bath, the secular baptism which gives the soul its first and imperishable tone and tint for taste and science.

And for this initiation a general, external acquaintance with the ancients is not sufficient; we must give ourselves to them in board and lodging, in order to suck in their air, their representations, their customs, even, if one wishes, their errors and prejudices, and to become at home in this world – the most beautiful world that has been.

If the first paradise was the paradise of human nature, this is the second, the higher one, the paradise of the human spirit, which emerges from its chamber like the bride, in its more beautiful naturalness, freedom, depth, and serenity.

The first wild magnificence of its rising in the Orient is circumscribed by the glory of form and tempered to beauty; it no longer has its depth in confusion, gloom, or inflation, but it lies open in unaffected clarity; its serenity is not a childish romping, but one spread over melancholy, which knows the hardness of fate yet is not driven by it out of the freedom above it and out of measure.
I do not think I am maintaining too much if I say that he who has not known the works of the ancients has lived without knowing beauty.
zh: 但倘若我们承认：总的说来凡事都当从精粹者出发，那么就较高的研习而言，希腊人的文学——首屈一指——然后是罗马人的文学，就既是并且必须继续是那个基础。
这些杰作的完善与光辉，必须是精神的浴池、世俗的洗礼，给灵魂注入对于品味与科学的第一次而永不磨灭的基调与成色。
而要做这一入门礼，同古人泛泛的、外在的相识并不够用；我们必须把自己寄食住在他们那里，以便吸吮他们的空气、他们的表象、他们的习俗，甚至——如有人愿意——他们的谬误与偏见，并在这世界里落户安家——在这曾经有过的最美丽的世界里。
如果说第一个乐园是人性底乐园，那么这就是第二个、更高的乐园，人类精神底乐园，精神以它更美的自然、自由、深邃与明朗，如新妇从洞房里走出来。
它在东方初升时那原初的蛮荒壮丽，已被形式之光辉圈起来，节制成美；它的深邃不再在混沌、阴郁或夸诞之中，而是敞开着，在无矫饰的明彻里；它的明朗不是儿童的嬉闹，而是铺在怅惘之上的开朗——那怅惘懂得命运的严酷，却不被命运赶出凌驾于它之上的自由、赶出节度。
我想我并未说得太满：谁不曾认识古人的著作，谁就未曾认识美而活过。

en: In such an element now, while we [dwell] in it, it comes about not only that all powers of the soul are aroused, developed, and exercised, but the same is a proprietary content through which we enrich ourselves and prepare our better substance.
zh: 而处在这种元素里、[入住]其中的时候，事情不仅是灵魂的一切能力被激起、被发展、被操练，这种元素本身就是一种自有之材，我们借它以自丰，并准备好我们较好的实体。

en: It has been said that intellectual activity can be exercised upon any material, and as the most purposeful material have appeared partly what is externally useful, partly the sensuous objects most appropriate to juvenile or childlike age, since they belong to the circle and manner of representing which this age already has in and for itself.
zh: 有人说过，精神的任何一种材料都可以用来操练精神活动；而最合用的材料，被认为一部分是外在有用的东西，一部分是适龄于少年或童稚的感性对象，因为它们本来就属于这一年龄自在自为已有的表象范围与表象方式。

en: If perhaps, perhaps not, the formal could be separable from the matter, the exercise itself from the objective circle on which it is to take place, and indifferent to it, still it is not a matter of exercise alone.

Just as the plant not only exercises its powers of reproduction in light and air but in this process simultaneously sucks in its nourishment, so the material on which the understanding and the capacity of the soul as such develop and exercise themselves must at the same time be a nourishment.

Not that so-called useful material, that sensuous matter-of-materials as it falls immediately into the way of representing of the child, but only the intellectual content which has worth and interest in and for itself, strengthens the soul and procures that independent hold, that substantial inwardness which is the mother of composure, of self-possession, of presence and wakefulness of spirit; it matures the soul reared upon it into a kernel of independent worth, of absolute purpose, which first constitutes the foundation of usability for everything, and which it is important to plant in all estates.

Have we not in recent times even seen states themselves, which neglected and despised preserving and building up such an inner background in the soul of their members, which directed them to mere utility and to the intellectual only as to a means, stand in dangers without poise and collapse in the midst of their many useful means?
zh: 即便——或并不——形式可以同物质分离、操练可以同它所依据的对象范围分离并对之漠然无动于衷，事情也终究不只是操练。
正如植物在光和空气里不仅施展自己繁殖的能力，而且在这过程中同时吸进自己的营养；同样，知性同灵魂一般的能力在其上发展、操练的材料，也同时必须是一种营养。
并不是所谓有用的材料，那种直接落进儿童表象方式里的感性的物质杂多，而只有自在自为有价值、有利害关系的精神内容，才使灵魂坚强，才提供那种独立的把握、那种实体性的内在性——它是镇定、是自重、是精神的在场与清醒之母；它把在自身上面养成的灵魂催熟为一颗具有独立价值、绝对目的之核，而这核才首先构成一切用处的基础，是应当在一切等级中播种的东西。
近代以来，我们难道没有亲眼看到这样的国家本身：它们荒废并蔑视在其国民的灵魂里保持并筑起这样内在的背景，把它们引向单纯有用处、引向只把精神的东西当作手段——结果大难临头便失重倒地，在它们众多有用的手段中间轰然崩塌？

en: The noblest nourishing material in the noblest form, the golden borders in silver vessels, the works of the ancients contain, and beyond comparison more than any other works of any time and nation.

I need only to recall the grandeur of their dispositions, their plastic virtue and patriotism free of moral equivocalness, the great style of their deeds and characters, the manifoldness of their fates, of their customs and constitutions, in order to justify the assertion that in the compass of no education was so much of the excellent, the admirable, the original, the manifold, and the instructive combined.
zh: 古人的著作包含着最精粹的营养之材、以最高贵的形式——金边的银盏——而有比较任何时代任何民族的其他著作都不啻万万倍之丰富。
我只需一提他们心态的伟大，他们那种雕塑般的、不带道德上暧昧两可性的美德与爱国心，他们事迹与人物的宏伟风格，他们命运、风俗、宪法的丰富多样，就足以证明这一论断：在没有任何一种教养的范围内，曾会聚了这样多的精粹、可惊叹者、原创者、多方面者与可教益者。

en: But this wealth is bound to the language, and only through and in this do we reach it in its whole peculiarity.
Translations perhaps give us the content, but not the form, not the ethereal soul of the same.
They resemble the counterfeit roses which in shape, colour, perhaps also fragrance, can be similar to the natural ones; but the loveliness, delicacy, and softness of life the former do not attain.
Or the rest of the prettiness and fineness of the copy belongs only to that copy in which a contrast between the content and the form not grown with it makes itself felt.

Language is the musical element, the element of intimacy, which vanishes in the translation – the fine fragrance through which the soul’s sympathy gives itself to be enjoyed, but without which a work of the ancients tastes only like Rhenish wine that has evaporated.
zh: 但这种财富系于语言，只有通过语言并在语言之中，我们才能在其全部特性中达到它。
译本也许能给我们内容，却不能给形式，不能给内容那以太般的灵魂。
译本像仿制的玫瑰：形状、颜色，也许连香气，都可以和真的相像；但生命的那种娇媚、柔嫩、温润，仿制品是达不到的。
或者，摹本其余的那份精巧与细腻只属于这样的摹本：在其中，内容同并非随它一同生长起来的形式之间的对照，令人感到了刺。
语言是音乐性的元素、亲切性的元素，它在转译中消逝——是那精致的芬芳，灵魂之同情借它把自己交付享受；没有了这芬芳，古人的作品尝起来就淡如跑光了酒香的莱茵葡萄酒。

en: This circumstance lays upon us the necessity which may seem hard, to study the languages of the ancients thoroughly and make ourselves fluent in them, in order to enjoy their works in the possible extent of all their sides and excellencies.

If we wanted to complain of the toil which we must devote to this, and could fear or regret having to put behind the acquisition of other cognitions and skills on its account, then we should have to accuse the fate which has not allotted to us in our own language this circle of classical works which would have made the laborious journey to antiquity superfluous and furnished the substitute for it.
zh: 这一点境况给我们压上了一个看似严峻的必然性：彻底研习古人的语言、把它练到得心应手，以便尽其所有方面与优长的最大限度来享受他们的作品。
倘若我们要抱怨为此须下的功夫，倘若我们担心或悔恨为此而把其他知识与技能的获得排在后面，那我们就只能归咎于命运：它没有在我们的本民族语言里派给我们这一圈古典著作，有了它，向古代的艰辛旅行就可以免了，它本身就可抵当古人。

en: After I have spoken of the material of education, this wish leads on to saying a few words also about what is formal and lies in its nature.
zh: 论过教养的材料之后，这一心愿又引着我说几句话，论论那属于形式的、存在于教养本性之中的东西。

en: The progression of education is namely not to be regarded as the quiet continuation of a chain to whose earlier links the following ones are indeed fitted with regard to them, but out of their own material and without this further work being directed against the former.
Rather, education must have an earlier material and object upon which it works, which it alters and newly forms.

It is necessary that we acquire the world of antiquity – as much in order to possess it as, even more, in order to have something that we may work up. – But in order to become an object, the substance of nature and of spirit must have stepped opposite to us, it must have received the shape of something alien. – Unhappy the man to whom his immediate world of feelings is alienated; for this means nothing other than that the individual bonds which wed heart and thought in a sacred way to life – faith, love, and trust – are torn asunder for him! – For the alienation which is a condition of theoretical education, the latter does not demand that moral pain, that suffering of the heart, but the lighter pain and effort of the representation, to occupy itself with a non-immediate, with something alien, with something belonging to memory, remembrance, and thinking. – But this demand of separation is so necessary that it expresses itself in us as a universal and known drive.

The alien, the distant carries with it the attractive interest which lures us to toil and effort, and the desirable stands in inverse proportion to the closeness in which it stands and is common with us.
Youth represents it to itself as a happiness, to get away from the native and with Robinson to inhabit a distant island.

It is a necessary illusion, to have to seek depth first in the shape of distance; but the depth and power we attain can only be measured by the breadth into which we fled from the center in which we first found ourselves immersed and toward which we again strive.
zh: 教养的进展，不应看作一条链条的平静接续：后头的环节固然顾及前面的环节而接上去，却用的是自己的物质，而且这进一步的劳作并不针对前者。
毋宁说，教养必须有一个更早的材料与对象，它在其上加工，把它改变并重新塑形。

我们必须获得古代的世界——既为着占有它，更为着有一个可供我们加工的对象。——但要成为对象，自然与精神的实体必须站到我们的对面，必须取得异乡东西的形态。——不幸啊，那他的直接的感觉世界被夺走的人！因为这无异于说：把心灵和思想神圣地同生命结合在一起的个体性的纽带——信仰、爱与信赖——为他断裂了！——而理论教养以之为条件的那种疏离，并不索取那种伦理的痛苦、心灵的苦难，只索取较轻的痛苦，即表象的努力：使自己去忙于那非直接的东西、一个陌生的东西、一个属于记忆、回忆与思维的东西。——但这分离的要求是这样必然，以致它在我们心中表现为一种普遍的、人人共知的冲动。
陌生的东西、遥远的东西带着那诱人的趣味，引我们去做工、去用力；值得欲求者，同它所处的临近程度、同它和我们的共通程度，恰成反比例关系。
少年们把这想象为一种幸运：离开家乡，同鲁滨逊一起住一个远的海岛。
不得不到远处去寻求深度——这是一种必要的错觉；但我们所达到的深度与力量，却只能以我们从中逃出的那个中心之外的广度来衡量——我们最初就沉浸在那个中心里，而现在又向它奔赴。

en: On this centrifugal drive of the soul now rests, in general, the necessity of presenting to it itself the separation which it seeks from its natural being and condition, of setting a distant, alien world into the young spirit.

But the partition wall by which this separation is effected for the education of which here we speak, is the world and language of the ancients; yet it, which separates us from ourselves, at the same time contains all the starting points and threads of the return to oneself, of reconciliation with it, and of the finding of oneself, yet of oneself according to the true universal essence of spirit.
zh: 灵魂这离心冲动之上，就一般说来，正奠着这样一个必然性：要把灵魂寻求同其自然本质与自然状况相分离的那件事摆到它自己面前，要把一个遥远的、陌生的世界放进少年的精神里。
而在这里所论的教养上，完成这分离的那堵隔墙，就是古人的世界与语言；然而这同我们自身隔离开我们的隔墙，同时又包蕴着回到自身、同自身修好、重新寻见自身——按精神之真正的普遍本质寻见自身——的一切端点与线头。

en: This universal necessity, which embraces the world of representation just as much as language as such – if we apply it to the learning of the latter, it becomes self-evident that the mechanical side of it is more than a merely necessary evil.
For the mechanical is the [to] spirit alien, for whom it has an interest to digest what is laid into it undigested, to vitalize what is still lifeless in it and to make it his own property.
zh: 这一普遍的必然性，既罩住表象世界，也罩住语言之为语言——把它应用到语言的学习上，就不言自明：学习中的机械一面，就远不只是必要的恶了。
因为机械的东西就是[对]精神说来陌生的东西，而精神于它偏有利害关系：要把放进它里面未经消化的东西消化掉，要把它里面还没有生命的东西化为生命，变成自己的财产。

en: With this mechanical moment of language learning there connects itself directly the grammatical study, whose value cannot be rated too highly, for it makes the beginning of logical education – a side which I touch upon last of all because it seems to have fallen almost into oblivion.
Grammar namely has the categories, the peculiar product and determinations of the understanding, for its content; in it, therefore, the understanding itself begins to be learned.

These most intellectual essences, with which it first makes us acquainted, are something highly graspable for youth, and hardly anything intellectual [is] more graspable than they; for the not yet comprehensive power of this age cannot take in the rich in its manifoldness; but those abstractions are the wholly simple.

They are as it were the single letters, indeed the vowels of the intellectual, with which we begin, [in order] to spell intellectual things and then learn to read them. – Then grammar also sets them forth in a way appropriate to this age, in that it teaches us to distinguish them by external auxiliary marks which language for the most part itself contains; something better than what everyone can do, telling red from blue without being able to state the definitions of these colors according to the Newtonian hypothesis or any other theory, suffices for the present, and it is most important to have been made attentive to these distinctions.

For if the determinations of the understanding, because we are intelligent beings, are in us and we immediately understand them, then the first education consists in having them, that is, in having made them objects of consciousness and being able to distinguish them by marks.
zh: 同语言学习的这一机械环节直接连在一起的，是语法研习，其价值怎样估量都不为过高，因为它构成逻辑教养的开端——这一面我放在最后提及，因为它几乎已被人遗忘了。
因为语法以范畴、以知性的特有产物和规定为内容；所以在语法里，知性本身才开始成为学习对象。
语法首先教我们相识的这些最精神的本质，对少年说来是极可把握的东西，而精神的任何东西都难得比它们更可把握；因为这一年龄尚不周流的能力，承受不了丰富在其驳杂中的样子；而那些抽象却正是全然的单纯。
它们可以说就是精神物的单个字母，而且是其中的元音，我们从它们起手，[为的是]把精神的东西拼读，然后学会通读。——然后语法也以适合这一年龄的方式把它们陈述出来：它教我们凭外在的辅助标记来分辨它们，而这些标记语言本身多半就有。这分辨的功夫，比人人都能分辨红蓝却讲不出按牛顿假说或其他任何理论的颜色定义要高一等；这初步的知识眼下就够用了，而被人提醒去注意这些差别，是最要紧的事。
因为知性的规定既然由于我们是有知性的存在者而就在我们里面，我们也就直接懂得它们；然而最初的教养在于拥有它们，亦即把它们变成了意识的对象，并能凭标记加以分辨。

en: Since through the grammatical terminology we learn to move in abstractions, and this study is to be regarded as the elementary philosophy, it is to be considered not merely as a means but as an end – both in the instruction in Latin and in that in German.

The general superficial thoughtlessness, which it required the whole earnestness and violence of the shocks we have experienced to drive out, had, as in other respects, so also here notoriously inverted the relation of means and end and esteemed the material knowledge of a language higher than its intelligent side. – The grammatical learning of an old language has at the same time the advantage of having to be a sustained and uninterrupted activity of reason; since here it is not, as in the mother tongue, unreflected habit that brings about the correct word order, but it is necessary to have before one’s eyes the value of the parts of speech as determined by the understanding and to call to aid the rule for their connection.

But thereby a constant subsuming of the particular under the universal and a particularizing of the universal takes place, and this is just the form of the activity of reason. – The strict grammatical study therefore presents itself as one of the most universal and noblest means of education.
zh: 我们既然通过语法术语学会了在抽象中活动，而这门研习又应看作入门的哲学，那它就不只是作为手段，也作为目的来对待——无论对拉丁文的教学还是对德文的教学都是这样。
那种普遍的、肤浅的轻率——非得靠我们经历过的全部震动之严肃与强力才把它驱走——在别的方面也罢，在这里也罢，众所周知都曾颠倒手段与目的之关系，把一门语言的材料知识看得高于它的悟性一面。——而一门古代语言的语法学习同时占有这个优势：它必须是一种持续不断的理性活动；因为在这里，不像在母语里那样由不假反思的习惯来造成正确的词序，而是必须把被知性所规定的词类的价值放在眼前，并把规则召来帮助词与词的连接。
但这样一来，就发生着不停顿地把特殊归摄到普遍之下、又把普遍特殊化的过程，而理性活动的形式正就在这里面。——所以严格的语法研习就显示为最普遍、最高贵的教养手段之一。

en: This taken together, the study of the ancients in their own language and the grammatical study, constitutes the basic features of the principle which characterizes our establishment.
This important good, rich though it already is in itself, does not on that account comprehend the whole extent of the cognitions into which our preparatory establishment initiates.

Besides that the reading of the ancient classics is already so chosen as to offer an instructive content, the establishment also embraces instruction in further cognitions which have a worth in and for themselves, are of special utility, or are also an ornament.

I need only to name these subjects here; their extent, their manner of treatment, the ordered gradation of stages in them and in their relations to others, the exercises attached to them, may be seen more fully in the notice to be distributed in print.

These subjects are then in general: religious instruction, German language together with acquaintance with the national classics, arithmetic, later algebra, geometry, geography, history, physiography which comprehends cosmography, natural history, and physics within itself, philosophical preparatory sciences; further French and, for the future theologians also Hebrew language, drawing and calligraphy.

How little these cognitions are neglected results from the simple calculation that, if we do not count the last four subjects of instruction, between those first named and the old languages the time of instruction in all classes is divided exactly in half; while, if the said subjects are included, there falls to the study of the old languages not the half but only two fifths of the whole instruction.
zh: 合起来的这一套——以古人自己的语言研习古人，加上语法研习——就构成了我们学园所本的原理的纲领，正是它标志出本校的性格。
这一重要的财富，虽然就自身已经这样丰富，却并不因此就包尽我们这一预备学园所引入的知识的全体范围。
除了古代经典作者的选读本身已选得能够提供富有教益的内容以外，学园还兼包进一步各科知识的教学：它们或自在自为有价值，或特别有用，或也是一种光彩。
我这里只需把这些科目名一下；它们的范围、处理方式、它们自身内以及它们相互关系上分阶段的秩序、系属于它们的练习，都可以在印行分发的说明书里详细看到。
这些科目大体是：宗教课、德语连同对祖国古典作家的熟悉、算术以及后来的代数、几何、地理、历史、自然志（它把宇宙志、自然史与物理学包在自身内）、哲学预备学科；此外还有法语，以及为将来神学生开设的希伯来语、图画与书法。
这些知识受何等轻视，从一笔简单的账就能看出：倘若最后四门教学不计在内，那么在先提到的诸科目同古代语言之间，所有班级的教学时间恰好平分；而把上述诸科目也算入，古代语言的研习所占的就不是全数的一半，而只是全数的五分之二。

en: In this first year now past, the main point has been put in order and got under way; the second year will be able to devote itself more particularly to the further determination and cultivation of individual branches, such as, e.g., the elements of physical sciences, and the most high grace of His Royal Majesty will, as we await with confident assurance, put us in a condition to do so. – Also what is still lacking in external arrangement and propriety – the Muses have few needs in themselves and are not spoiled here – what is still required for the exercise of external disciplinary oversight – and the nature of the disposition here and the interest of parents in the good bearing of their children lightens this care – and such collateral needs see their remedy already on the way.
zh: 在这已经过去的第一年里，根本大事已经安排就绪、运转起来；第二年将能更专门地留意若干分支的进一步确定与培育，比如各门物理学初级；陛下至高的恩典，也必将一如我们满怀信赖的期望所等待的那样，把条件齐备地赐给我们。——至于外部的设备与布置上还有不足处——缪斯本就少有需索，在此也不曾娇惯——以及外部的训育监察上尚有所需——此地风气的本性、家长对子女仪度的利害关系，都使这份操劳轻了许多——以及此类支节的需要，也都已看到补救已在途中。

en: The general effects of the most high gracious ordinances, of the most gracious nearer oversight and activity of the Royal General Commissariat, and of the efforts of the teachers correspondent to the same, the public has had opportunity to judge in the public examinations. – The last act with which we conclude it is this public solemnity, by which the most gracious government wishes to add to its establishments still the moment of honor and of public attestation of satisfaction with the progress of the studying pupils.
zh: 至高而恩霈的种种章程、王家总署恩霈的就近监察与振作，以及教师们的相应努力，它们的总效果，公众已借公开考试得以论定。——我们结束这一年工作的最后一幕，就是今天的公开盛典：至仁的政府要借此给它的学园再添上荣誉这个环节，以及对就学诸生的进步感到满意这一公开的表现。

en: A part of you, gentlemen, has already received a mark of the most gracious satisfaction in the permission to enter the university; you saw therein that the eye of the government is open upon you; be convinced that it will always be open upon you, that you owe the same an accounting of the use of your years of study and of the most graciously granted admission to the Royal establishments, that in our fatherland every career lies open to your talents and application, but is passable only for merit.
Continue then bravely on the university the work which you have begun here.

Most of you leave your father’s house for the first time; as you once already tore yourselves away from your mother’s heart when you entered the first life, so you now sever yourselves from the life of your family in taking the step into the estate of self-subsistence.
Youth looks forward; do not in doing so forget the backward glance of thanks, of love, and of duty toward your parents.
zh: 在座诸君中的一部分，已经得到恩霈嘉许的明证，蒙准升入大学；你们从中看到了政府的眼目始终睁着注视着你们；请坚信这只眼将不断注视着你们，你们要向政府交代你们的求学岁月、交代它恩准你们进入王家学府的受用如何——在我们的祖国，你们的才具与勤勉面前，条条道路都是敞开着的，而唯独有功劳的才走得通。
那么，请在大学里继续勇敢地作完你们在这里开了端的工作。
你们中大多数人是头一回离开父家；你们当初踏进最初的生命时即已同母亲的心分离过一次，如今更是从家庭生活里分离出去，因为你们正跨进自立自存的地位。
少年总是向前看；向前看的时候，请不要忘了向着父母回首致谢、致谢于爱、尽你们那回顾的义务。

en: The judgments of the teachers on each individual of all pupils will be read out to them in the presence of all teachers and of the classmates of the class; this censure will, upon request, also be communicated to the parents in writing.

The short result of this judgment is the place of progress which each receives, according to his total progress, among the classmates of his class, through the deliberation of the teachers and the confirmation of the rectorate.
The order of these places is a testimony of what each of you has already accomplished; it is made public here and then through the press.
zh: 教师对全体学生每一人的判断，将当着全体教师与其班级同学之面宣读；这一考语，如有索取，也以书面通告家长。
这一判断的简截结果，就是每个人按他的全课总成绩，在他本班级同学中所居的进学名次——这名次由教师们合议确定，并经校长处核准。
这些名次的次第，就是你们每人已经做出了什么的见证；它今天当众宣布，随后付印公开。

en: More solemn is the distinction of those who have distinguished themselves pre-eminently among their classmates, and whose reward and prize now awaits them from the hand of His Excellency the General Commissar.

Receive it as a sign of satisfaction with what you have accomplished hitherto, and still more as an encouragement for your future conduct – as an honour that befalls you, but still more as a new claim upon your further effort, as a higher right that your parents, your teachers, the fatherland, and the most high government have acquired upon you.
zh: 更为庄重的，是那在同窗中出类拔萃者的荣典：他们的奖励与奖品，此刻正等着从诸位阁下一位总署大臣的手中授出。
请把它当作对你迄今所成之事的满意之标记来领受，更把它当作对你将来言行的勉励来领受——当作落到你们身上的荣誉，更当作对你再行奋发的新要求权，当作你的家长、你的师长、你的祖国、至高的政府在你身上赢来的更高权利。
